messages.author: e24df9c5e751733e
messages.subject: pystan error
parts:
Hello,
I have installed CmdStan 2.12.0 and I want to use pystan interface.

I have installed it by pip install pystan in Linux and I followed all the installation guideline from http://pystan.readthedocs.io/en/latest/getting_started.html.

I tried to run the ''eight schools'' example (Using Anaconda, Spyder), however, I get the following error:

runfile('/tmp/eightschools.py', wdir='/tmp')
INFO:pystan:COMPILING THE C++ CODE FOR MODEL anon_model_95013624776d537c3cd7cd4d641c30e0 NOW.

Traceback (most recent call last):

  File "<ipython-input-4-4bf35c3dbe9f>", line 1, in <module>
    runfile('/tmp/eightschools.py', wdir='/tmp')

  File "/home/meysam/anaconda2/lib/python2.7/site-packages/spyder/utils/site/sitecustomize.py", line 866, in runfile
    execfile(filename, namespace)

  File "/home/meysam/anaconda2/lib/python2.7/site-packages/spyder/utils/site/sitecustomize.py", line 94, in execfile
    builtins.execfile(filename, *where)

  File "/tmp/eightschools.py", line 37, in <module>
    iter=1000, chains=4)

  File "/home/meysam/anaconda2/lib/python2.7/site-packages/pystan/api.py", line 368, in stan
    verbose=verbose)

  File "/home/meysam/anaconda2/lib/python2.7/site-packages/pystan/model.py", line 315, in __init__
    self.module = load_module(module_name, lib_dir)

  File "/home/meysam/anaconda2/lib/python2.7/site-packages/pystan/model.py", line 54, in load_module
    return imp.load_module(module_name, *module_info)

ImportError: /tmp/tmpUuZRKW/pystan/stanfit4anon_model_95013624776d537c3cd7cd4d641c30e0_724952c86beb130db392f6b01aa1ef05.so: undefined symbol: _ZNSt8ios_base7failureB5cxx11D1Ev


I run the code from /tmp, from /home, /desktop and anywhere else, Itried other installing way (from github,...) but I get the same error.

With pymc3 I don't have any compiling problem and I compiled this example by pystan in Mac OS without any problem!


Somebody can help me?
Thank you so much in advance.
Best regards,
Meysam

messages.author: 6303bca1668d79af
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] pystan error
parts:
I think the conclusion was that there's a problem with Anaconda's
libstdc++. If your compiler is more recent than Anaconda's (which it
will be if you use a new version of Ubuntu), a problem arises. Here's a
FAQ about it:
https://github.com/GalSim-developers/GalSim/wiki/Installation-FAQ#why-is-scons-unable-to-build-a-python-loadable-module-that-uses-tmv-using-anaconda
